== Notes ==
* The health degeneration will affect spirits and cannot be removed (i.e. it is not a [[hex spell|hex]]).
* The degeneration does not [[effect stacking|stack]]; if a foe is affected by a second Cry of Pain, the [[duration]] will be renewed.
* The damage and degeneration will be applied regardless of whether a skill was interrupted.
* The concise description is slightly unclear as to whom the health degeneration will be applied.
{{Anomaly|This is the only skill that has health degeneration shown with positive value in the description.}}

== Trivia ==
* The [[skill icon]] is similar to [[Anguish]].
* Before being updated on the [[Game updates/20090618|June 18, 2009]], this was the main skill used in several [[build]]s often known as [[Cryway]] builds.
